name: CubeSmart on Manuel Drive
summary: CubeSmart at 219 Manuel Drive lists heated-and-cooled and drive-up rooms. Drive-up means you can park at the door. Checked Nov 26, 2026, on CubeSmart's own page, a climate 5x10 is $57.60 online and $96 in the store, under first month free and 40% off. Storage.com lists the same lowest prices and a $29 admin fee. Ask how many months the discount lasts before you budget it.

fees.label: One-time administrative fee
fees.note: Storage.com calls this a fee from the facility, due when you move in. CubeSmart's own page names a one-time administrative fee and does not print the amount. Checked Nov 26, 2026.
